text.en: Parent company of the Cathay Group; HK Express (low-cost) and Air Hong Kong (all-cargo) are its wholly owned subsidiaries.
text.zh-Hant: 國泰集團母公司；低成本航空公司 HK Express 及全貨運航空公司香港華民航空均為其全資附屬公司

text.en: Cathay Pacific was established and flew its first flight, Sydney to Hong Kong, in a DC-3 nicknamed 'Betsy'.
text.zh-Hant: 國泰航空成立，以DC-3客機「Betsy」首航，由悉尼飛抵香港

text.en: Swire became a key shareholder.
text.zh-Hant: 太古成為國泰航空的主要股東

text.en: Bought its first Convair 880 jet; the fleet was fully jet-powered by 1967.
text.zh-Hant: 購入首架Convair 880噴射客機，1967年機隊全面噴射化

text.en: Welcomed its first Boeing 747, VR-HKG.
text.zh-Hant: 引入首架波音747客機VR-HKG

text.en: Began passenger service to the Chinese Mainland with a first flight to Shanghai in June.
text.zh-Hant: 6月首航上海，開辦往中國內地的客運航班

text.en: Operated the first commercial landing at Chek Lap Kok and established the oneworld alliance with partners.
text.zh-Hant: 完成赤鱲角機場首個商業航班降落，並與夥伴創立寰宇一家

text.en: Renamed its master brand Cathay; the cargo business became Cathay Cargo.
text.zh-Hant: 主品牌易名為「國泰」，貨運業務改稱國泰貨運

text.en: Celebrated 80 years, with a route network of 100 global destinations.
text.zh-Hant: 慶祝成立80周年，航線網絡達全球100個航點

text.en: Cathay Pacific launched daily non-stop flights between Hong Kong and Changsha.
text.zh-Hant: 國泰航空開辦香港至長沙每日直航

text.en: Cathay Pacific returned to Adelaide with a thrice-weekly seasonal service.
text.zh-Hant: 國泰航空恢復香港至阿德萊德季節性航班，每周三班

text.en: Cathay Pacific resumed non-stop Hong Kong–Seattle flights, five times a week.
text.zh-Hant: 國泰航空恢復香港至西雅圖直航，每周五班

text.en: Cathay Cargo exercised purchase rights for two more Airbus A350F freighters, taking its order to eight.
text.zh-Hant: 國泰貨運行使購買權增購兩架空中巴士A350F貨機，訂單增至八架

text.en: Cathay Pacific announced plans to fly three times a week to Almaty from the first quarter of 2027.
text.zh-Hant: 國泰航空宣布計劃於2027年第一季開辦往阿拉木圖航班，每周三班

text.en: Dubai and Riyadh passenger flights temporarily suspended since March 2026 (reported in the 2026 interim report).
text.zh-Hant: 杜拜及利雅得客運航班自2026年3月起暫停（2026年中期報告）

text.en: Winter service to Cairns to be suspended from October 2026 (reported in the 2026 interim report).
text.zh-Hant: 由2026年10月起暫停凱恩斯冬季航班（2026年中期報告）

text.en: Kuala Lumpur increased from three to four daily return flights from March 2026.
text.zh-Hant: 吉隆坡航班由2026年3月起由每日三班增至四班

text.en: Seoul increased from four to five daily flights in March 2026.
text.zh-Hant: 首爾航班於2026年3月由每日四班增至五班

text.en: Xi'an to increase from a daily service to 12 return flights a week from 11 July 2026.
text.zh-Hant: 西安航班由2026年7月11日起由每日一班增至每周12班

text.en: Low-cost airline based in Hong Kong; a wholly owned subsidiary of Cathay Pacific Airways in the Cathay Group.
text.zh-Hant: 以香港為基地的低成本航空公司，國泰集團成員，為國泰航空的全資附屬公司

text.en: Became Hong Kong's sole low-cost carrier on 27 October 2013.
text.zh-Hant: 2013年10月27日起成為香港唯一的低成本航空公司

text.en: Took delivery of its first Airbus A321neo.
text.zh-Hant: 接收首架空中巴士A321neo客機

text.en: Inaugurated its route to Beijing Daxing International Airport.
text.zh-Hant: 開辦往北京大興國際機場的航線

text.en: Welcomed its 10th Airbus A321neo.
text.zh-Hant: 接收第10架空中巴士A321neo客機

text.en: Became the first airline to hire Hong Kong International Aviation Academy cadet pilot graduates, as Second Officers.
text.zh-Hant: 首家聘用香港國際航空學院學員機師課程畢業生出任二副的航空公司

text.en: Named World's Best Low-Cost Carrier 2026 by AirlineRatings.
text.zh-Hant: 獲AirlineRatings評為2026年全球最佳低成本航空公司

text.en: Commenced operations at Terminal 2 of Hong Kong International Airport.
text.zh-Hant: 於香港國際機場二號客運大樓開始營運

text.en: HK Express launched a new route between Hong Kong and Kota Kinabalu (Sabah).
text.zh-Hant: HK Express 開辦香港至亞庇（沙巴）新航線

text.en: HK Express launched daily direct flights between Hong Kong and Wuxi.
text.zh-Hant: HK Express 開辦香港至無錫每日直航

text.en: HK Express announced a new Hefei route from 3 December 2026, with four flights a week.
text.zh-Hant: HK Express 宣布2026年12月3日起開辦合肥航線，每周四班

text.en: HK Express suspended Hualien from January 2026 and Guiyang from May 2026 (2026 interim report).
text.zh-Hant: HK Express 由2026年1月起暫停花蓮航線，5月起暫停貴陽航線（2026年中期報告）

text.en: HK Express suspended Nha Trang from January 2026 (2026 interim report).
text.zh-Hant: HK Express 由2026年1月起暫停芽莊航線（2026年中期報告）

text.en: Greater Bay Airlines Company Limited, incorporated and headquartered in Hong Kong, with Hong Kong as its principal place of business
text.zh-Hant: 大灣區航空公司總部設於香港，在香港註冊並以香港為主要經營地

text.en: Received its first aircraft (September 2021)
text.zh-Hant: 2021年9月接收首架飛機

text.en: Received its Air Operator's Certificate from the Civil Aviation Department
text.zh-Hant: 獲香港民航處發出航空營運人證書

text.en: Licensed by the Air Transport Licensing Authority for scheduled services on 104 routes
text.zh-Hant: 獲航空運輸牌照局發牌，可經營104條定期航線

text.en: Commenced scheduled service in July 2022
text.zh-Hant: 2022年7月開始提供定期航班服務

text.en: Ordered 15 Boeing 737-9s, with a commitment for at least five 787s
text.zh-Hant: 訂購15架波音737-9，並承諾購買不少於5架787

text.en: Became an IATA member after completing the IOSA audit
text.zh-Hant: 完成IOSA認證後成為國際航空運輸協會會員

text.en: First Boeing 737-9 delivered and entered service
text.zh-Hant: 首架波音737-9客機交付並投入服務

text.en: Moved check-in at HKIA from Terminal 1 to the new Terminal 2
text.zh-Hant: 香港國際機場登記服務由一號客運大樓遷往二號客運大樓

text.en: Seasonal Da Nang service, 17 December 2025 to 3 January 2026, 10 round trips
text.zh-Hant: 2025年12月17日至2026年1月3日新增峴港季節性航班，合共10班

text.en: Seasonal daily Male (Maldives) service, 8 to 25 February 2026
text.zh-Hant: 2026年2月8日至25日推出馬爾代夫馬累季節性航班，每日1班

text.en: First Boeing 737-9 delivered (arrived 22 November 2025) and in service
text.zh-Hant: 首架波音737-9客機交付（11月22日抵港）並投入服務

text.en: Seasonal Kuala Lumpur service, 13 to 24 February 2026, 12 round trips
text.zh-Hant: 2026年2月13日至24日推出吉隆坡季節性航班，合共12班

text.en: Scheduled Hohhot service began on 6 February 2026, four flights a week
text.zh-Hant: 呼和浩特定期航班2月6日投入服務，每星期4班

text.en: Seasonal Phuket service, 29 March to 13 April 2026, 12 round trips
text.zh-Hant: 2026年3月29日至4月13日推出布吉季節性航班，合共12班

text.en: Seasonal daily Okinawa (Naha) service, 11 July to 24 October 2026
text.zh-Hant: 7月11日至10月24日推出沖繩（那霸）季節性航班，每日1班

text.en: Seasonal Urumqi service, 3 September to 7 October 2026, three flights a week
text.zh-Hant: 9月3日至10月7日推出烏魯木齊季節性航班，每周三班

text.en: Seasonal Chongqing service, 4 September to 16 October 2026, three flights a week
text.zh-Hant: 9月4日至10月16日推出重慶季節性航班，每星期三班

text.en: Seasonal Kunming service, 3 September to 22 October 2026, three flights a week
text.zh-Hant: 9月3日至10月22日推出昆明季節性航班，每星期三班

text.en: Scheduled Surabaya service began on 25 September 2026, its first Indonesian route, four flights a week
text.zh-Hant: 泗水定期航班9月25日投入服務，為首條印尼航線，每星期4班

text.en: Hong Kong Airlines Limited, renamed from CR Airways Limited in 2006
text.zh-Hant: 香港航空有限公司，2006年由「中富航空有限公司」更名

text.en: CR Airways Limited renamed Hong Kong Airlines Limited; first Boeing 737 introduced
text.zh-Hant: 「中富航空有限公司」更名為「香港航空有限公司」，引入首架波音737客機

text.en: Fleet reached 10 aircraft with the first Airbus A330 passenger aircraft
text.zh-Hant: 營運機隊增至10架，並引入首架空中巴士A330客機

text.en: Rated four-star by Skytrax for the first time
text.zh-Hant: 首次獲Skytrax評定為四星級航空公司

text.en: Began operating an all-Airbus fleet
text.zh-Hant: 以全空中巴士機隊營運

text.en: Introduced its first Airbus A350 and launched a cadet pilot training programme
text.zh-Hant: 引入首架空中巴士A350客機，推出首屆見習機師培訓計劃

text.en: Official opening of the HKA Training Academy
text.zh-Hant: 香港航空飛行培訓中心揭幕啟用

text.en: First Airbus A321 joined the fleet
text.zh-Hant: 首架空中巴士A321加入機隊

text.en: Returned to long-haul markets with services to Sydney and Melbourne
text.zh-Hant: 重返國際長途航線市場，開通悉尼、墨爾本

text.en: Daily Hong Kong–Hanoi service to resume from 19 December 2025
text.zh-Hant: 2025年12月19日起恢復每日一班香港至河內直航

text.en: Melbourne service launched on 12 December, three flights a week (A330)
text.zh-Hant: 墨爾本直航於12月12日開通，每週三班，以A330營運

text.en: Hong Kong–Lanzhou service launched on 26 May 2026, once a week
text.zh-Hant: 香港至蘭州直航5月26日啟航，每週一班

text.en: Urumqi service launched on 29 August, twice weekly (A330)
text.zh-Hant: 香港至烏魯木齊直航8月29日啟航，每週兩班，以A330營運

headline.en: Cathay Cargo increases its A350F freighter order to eight
headline.zh-Hant: 國泰貨運把 A350F 貨機訂單增至八架

body.en: In its 2026 interim results, the Cathay Group said Cathay Cargo had raised its order for Airbus A350F freighters to eight aircraft. It also said a lease agreement was signed for an A330P2F converted freighter for Air Hong Kong.
body.zh-Hant: 國泰集團在 2026 年中期業績中表示，國泰貨運已把空中巴士 A350F 貨機訂單增至八架；集團亦表示已為香港華民航空簽訂一架 A330P2F 改裝貨機的租賃協議。

headline.en: Greater Bay Airlines receives its first Boeing 737-9
headline.zh-Hant: 大灣區航空接收首架波音 737-9

body.en: Greater Bay Airlines said its first Boeing 737-9 was delivered from Boeing's delivery centre in Seattle and arrived in Hong Kong on 22 November 2025, and had already entered service. The airline said it now flies Boeing 737-800 and 737-9 aircraft.
body.zh-Hant: 大灣區航空表示，其首架波音 737-9 從波音位於西雅圖的交付中心交付，並於 2025 年 11 月 22 日抵港，已投入服務。該公司表示，機隊現由波音 737-800 及 737-9 組成。

headline.en: Cathay Pacific adds Iberia codeshares via Madrid
headline.zh-Hant: 國泰航空經馬德里新增與西班牙國家航空的代碼共享航班

body.en: Cathay Pacific announced new codeshare flights via Madrid with oneworld partner Iberia to four cities: Buenos Aires (Argentina), Fortaleza and Recife (Brazil), and Santo Domingo (Dominican Republic). It said it would add three flights a week on its non-stop Hong Kong–Madrid route from 25 October 2026, making the route daily; it said the schedules are subject to change and regulatory approval.
body.zh-Hant: 國泰航空宣布經馬德里與寰宇一家夥伴西班牙國家航空新增代碼共享航班，前往四個城市：阿根廷布宜諾斯艾利斯、巴西福塔雷薩及累西腓，以及多明尼加共和國聖多明各。該公司表示，將由 2026 年 10 月 25 日起在香港至馬德里直航航線每週增加三班，使該航線增至每日一班；該公司表示航班時間表或會更改，並有待監管機構批准。

headline.en: Cathay Pacific announces plans for Almaty flights
headline.zh-Hant: 國泰航空宣布計劃開辦阿拉木圖航線

body.en: Cathay Pacific announced plans to start direct flights between Hong Kong and Almaty, Kazakhstan, in the first quarter of 2027. It said it plans three flights a week with an Airbus A330-300, and that Almaty would be its first destination in Central Asia.
body.zh-Hant: 國泰航空宣布計劃於 2027 年第一季開辦香港至哈薩克斯坦阿拉木圖的直航航班，並表示計劃每週三班，以空中巴士 A330-300 營運；阿拉木圖將是該公司在中亞的首個航點。

headline.en: HK Express announces daily flights to Wuxi
headline.zh-Hant: HK Express 宣布開辦每日無錫航班

body.en: HK Express announced a new daily direct route from Hong Kong to Wuxi Shuofang Airport, starting on 17 July 2026, subject to regulatory approval. It said that with Wuxi it would offer a total of 22 return flights a week across the Yangtze River Delta.
body.zh-Hant: HK Express 宣布由 2026 年 7 月 17 日起開辦香港至無錫碩放機場的每日直航航班（有待監管機構批准）；該公司表示，加上無錫航線後，其長江三角洲航線合共每週提供 22 班來回航班。

headline.en: Airport career fair opens with over 4,400 jobs
headline.zh-Hant: 機場招聘會開幕，提供逾 4,400 個職位

body.en: The HKIA Expo & Career Fair 2026, hosted by the Airport Authority Hong Kong and the Labour Department, opened in Terminal 2. The Airport Authority said about 40 airport companies offered over 4,400 job openings across areas such as inflight services, ground services and aircraft maintenance.
body.zh-Hant: 由香港機場管理局與勞工處合辦的香港國際機場 2026 年博覽及招聘會（HKIA Expo & Career Fair 2026）在二號客運大樓開幕。機管局表示，約 40 間機場公司提供逾 4,400 個職位空缺，涵蓋機上服務、地勤服務及飛機維修等範疇。

headline.en: HK Express hires 11 cadet graduates as Second Officers
headline.zh-Hant: HK Express 聘用 11 名見習機師畢業生為二副

body.en: HK Express and the Hong Kong International Aviation Academy (HKIAA) announced that HK Express had hired 11 graduates from the first intake of HKIAA's Cadet Pilot Programme as Second Officers. They said HK Express was the first airline to employ HKIAA cadet pilots, and that the programme had completed eight intakes.
body.zh-Hant: HK Express 與香港國際航空學院宣布，HK Express 已聘用 11 名學院首屆見習機師課程畢業生為二副（Second Officer）。雙方表示，HK Express 是首家聘用該學院見習機師的航空公司，課程當時已完成八屆招生。

headline.en: HKIA passenger traffic up 3.5% in August
headline.zh-Hant: 香港國際機場八月客運量上升 3.5%

body.en: The Airport Authority said HKIA handled 5.86 million passengers and 34,995 flight movements in August 2026, up 3.5% and 0.5% on a year earlier. Cargo fell 1.2% to 422,000 tonnes. Transfer and transit passengers recorded double-digit growth.
body.zh-Hant: 機管局表示，香港國際機場在 2026 年 8 月處理 586 萬人次旅客及 34,995 架次飛機起降，按年分別上升 3.5% 及 0.5%。貨運量下跌 1.2% 至 42.2 萬公噸。轉機及過境旅客錄得雙位數增長。

headline.zh-Hant: 香港國際機場二號客運大樓離港設施啟用

body.en: The departure facilities of HKIA's new Terminal 2 began operating on 27 May 2026. Hong Kong Airlines was the first airline to move its check-in counters from Terminal 1 to Terminal 2, and the Airport Authority said the other 14 airlines would move their check-in services in batches until 10 June.
body.zh-Hant: 香港國際機場新二號客運大樓的離港設施於 2026 年 5 月 27 日啟用。香港航空是首家把登機櫃位由一號客運大樓遷往二號客運大樓的航空公司；機管局表示，其餘 14 家航空公司的登機櫃位服務會分批遷移，直至 6 月 10 日。
